events.verdict: Brooks (HOU) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in front of Grimes (PHI) as he defends him off ball.
Smith Jr. (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves alongside Butler's (PHI) path to the basket.
Brissett (PHI) legally contests VanVleet's (HOU) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. Additionally, VanVleet extends his leg and initiates the marginal contact.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul called on VanVleet (HOU) meets the criteria for a flagrant foul penalty 2 and he is ejected from the game.
Grimes (PHI) places his off-arm against Green (HOU) and releases from contact.
Brooks (HOU) legally contests Grimes' (PHI) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Butler (PHI) lowers his arm down into Brooks' (HOU) already extended arm, but the contact is marginal and does not affect his pass.
Green (HOU) makes contact to Edwards' (PHI) hand on the ball during his play at the basket.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Brissett (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although the ball goes out of bounds, Brissett makes contact to Smith Jr.'s (HOU) wrist that causes him to lose control of the ball and the foul is deemed proximate to the play.
Tate (HOU) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball as Butler (PHI) passes.
Edwards (PHI) moves alongside Green's (HOU) path an the ensuing body contact is marginal during the driving shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) briefly grasps Brissett's (PHI) jersey, but releases as he pursues the rebound.
Butler (PHI) commits a take foul on Smith Jr. (HOU).
Smith Jr. (HOU) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Hood-Schifino (PHI) grabs and pulls Sengun's (HOU) jersey away from his body, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Butler (PHI) makes contact with the ball, causing it to come loose. Therefore, Sengun (HOU) legally recovers the ball and does not commit a violation.
Brooks (HOU) applies a hand to Grimes' (PHI) front, affecting his SQBR.
Holiday (HOU) legally contests Grimes' (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Grimes (PHI) attempts to go for the steal and initiates illegal contact with Sengun's (HOU) arm as he attempts to pass.
Brissett (PHI) establishes himself in a legal guarding position outside of the restricted area and Sengun (HOU) dislodges him from his position at the end of the drive.
Tate (HOU) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Butler (PHI).
Butler (PHI) loses his balance on his own accord and not a result of any illegal contact initiated by Holiday (HOU).
Butler (PHI) initiates contact with Holiday's (HOU) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Green (HOU) legally contests Grimes' (PHI) jump shot attempt.
